mapper.select: SELECT R.ROLE_CD AS roleCd, R.ROLE_NM AS roleNm, R.SORT_NO AS sortNo, R.BUILTIN AS builtin, R.USE_AT AS useAt, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM OPS_USER U WHERE U.ROLE = R.ROLE_CD) AS userCnt FROM OPS_ROLE R ORDER BY R.SORT_NO, R.ROLE_CD
SELECT ROLE_CD AS roleCd, ROLE_NM AS roleNm, SORT_NO AS sortNo, BUILTIN AS builtin, USE_AT AS useAt FROM OPS_ROLE WHERE USE_AT = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_NO, ROLE_CD
SELECT ROLE_CD AS roleCd, ROLE_NM AS roleNm, SORT_NO AS sortNo, BUILTIN AS builtin, USE_AT AS useAt FROM OPS_ROLE WHERE ROLE_CD = #{roleCd}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM OPS_ROLE WHERE ROLE_CD = #{roleCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_ROLE (ROLE_CD, ROLE_NM, SORT_NO, BUILTIN, USE_AT, REG_DT) VALUES (#{roleCd}, #{roleNm}, #{sortNo}, 'N', #{useAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM OPS_ROLE WHERE ROLE_CD = #{roleCd} AND BUILTIN = 'N'
